metadata.source: Glen Rock Borough Council & Glen Rock BOE Collective Bargaining Agreements

primaryPlans.description: In-network copay model replacing state SHBP coverage with predictable negotiated dental and prescription formularies.
Lower-cost plan option for certified educators capping employee contributions to an income-indexed percentage.

rules.employeeContribution: 12% to 35% of Total Premium (Indexed by Salary)
rules.note: Average Glen Rock municipal employee pays ~$4,800 to $9,200 annually toward family medical coverage, while taxpayers subsidize the remaining ~$27,200 to $31,600.

retirementAndLeaveBenefits.pensionSystems: PFRS (Police & Firemen's Retirement System) & TPAF/PERS (Teachers & Public Employees)
retirementAndLeaveBenefits.terminalLeaveCap: $15,000 statutory sick leave payout cap enforced for non-aligned personnel under state reform statutes.
